name: Orb #0
description:
Leaving this orbit for another, exostellar one. 

With five hundred twenty-six billion eight hundred forty-eight million unique combinations that create a unique auditory experience which will take you on a journey to the orbit of another planet. You might buy an island but not a whole planet, with moons and nebulas  included. Unless you buy this. With 6 different planet types with their own distinct sound, atmosphere and cloud patterns. These orbs will predict your and the future of humanity.
